decisions.quote:
This study replicates Hofstede’s
study with data obtained from students studying for their master degrees in different universities in Jordan.
decisions.reason: The study collects new primary survey data from 795 master's students across universities in Jordan using the VSM 94 questionnaire to re-test whether Hofstede's (1980) published cultural dimension findings for Arab countries hold in Jordan. Both shipped and blind coding rightly classify the record as a replication.
